target.role: fresh whole-journey belonging and placement discovery for STRANGE GAIT
target.position: Whole journey: before the opener, between every non-protected pair, or after the tail. Preserve only Transparency → When We Froze and When We Froze → Stardancer; Truth in Noise → Transparency remains available.
target.purpose: Test current, adjacent/emerging and overlooked material against its strongest plausible lawful placement rather than a predetermined tail slot. A candidate must strengthen transition, local-run and long-form intent; selection-lens interest alone is insufficient.

sourceWindows: CURRENT / ADJACENT: https://outerorbitrecords.bandcamp.com/album/bootstrap-paradox-lp and https://ra.co/reviews/36356 — all 12 listed album tracks from Spekki Webu's 2026-06-05 Bootstrap Paradox screened; Goodbye Universe retained because the track-specific review describes a broken-beat-ish, off-grid construction with backwards drum fills that become both jarring and funky.

CURRENT RELEASES: https://soma-records.bandcamp.com/album/soma-352-surgeon-remixes — all four tracks from the 2026-08-28 Surgeon remix release screened; Brownian Motion (Justyn Nell Remix) retained because Soma's exact-remix description foregrounds driving rhythms, precision percussion and explosive dynamics.

OVERLOOKED CATALOGUE: https://seismicrec.bandcamp.com/track/iii9 — all four tracks from Spekki Webu's 2023 Kept In Reality release screened; iii9 retained because its exact-track notes describe an offbeat gated lolloping pulse that later locks into polyrhythmic pressure.

ADDITIONAL WINDOWS: SWAY Ace Trax X2, Soma 35.2's other three remixes, the remaining Bootstrap Paradox tracks, and bounded August–September 2026 techno/broken-rhythm/polyrhythm result pages; exact Spotify identities intentionally left to the repository resolver.
explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 34 named tracks across four release/catalogue pages plus bounded current-release result windows; metadata and attributed descriptions only, with zero audio auditions.
exclusions: All 13 canonical identities, active placement-specific rejects, and every untriggered PARKED revisit were excluded. The Run 52 reassessment cohort was not recycled.
The two protected internal handoffs Transparency → When We Froze and When We Froze → Stardancer remain unavailable; Truth in Noise → Transparency and every other boundary remain available.

Wave Jumper, Axis Point, Floating In Acheron, and the remaining Bootstrap Paradox tracks had useful descriptions but ranked below Goodbye Universe for exact-track structural evidence; no same-artist diversity quota was applied when iii9 independently survived the overlooked-catalogue scan.
Coaster (Slam Mix), Coaster (Lewis Fautzi Remix), and Coaster (Nørbak Remix) were screened but ranked below Brownian Motion (Justyn Nell Remix) for this run's adjacent/emerging lane.

Recent Teknopappa, Atherian and M.S. sources previously screened in Run 48 were not recycled. No lead was promoted for recency, artist reputation, genre, title, novelty or assumed BPM. Energy, density, bodily effect, phrase structure, perceived pulse, harmonic relation and mixability remain unknown.
rankedLeadSummary: 1. Spekki Webu — Goodbye Universe: current track-specific review describes broken-beat-ish, live/off-grid behavior and backwards fills that land as jarring and funky; exact Spotify identity and tempo require resolver verification.

2. Surgeon — Brownian Motion (Justyn Nell Remix): current official label description attributes driving rhythms, precision percussion and explosive dynamics to the exact remix; exact Spotify crediting and tempo require resolver verification.

3. Spekki Webu — iii9: overlooked exact-track label notes describe offbeat gated rhythm, a lolloping pulse, evolving space and polyrhythms locking pressure; exact Spotify identity and tempo require resolver verification.
